clips.send: The exhaust valve opens and the intake valve stays closed. The rising piston pushes burned gases out of the cylinder. This is a simplified spark-ignition gasoline engine. The crankshaft turns twice (720°) per cycle, and expanding gases drive the piston during the power stroke. A flywheel and other rotating parts help carry the engine through the other strokes.

clips.send: Water has a higher specific heat than many land materials. The ocean warms slowly as it absorbs energy in warmer seasons and cools slowly as it releases energy in cooler seasons. Winds can carry air from over the ocean onto land, reducing temperature swings near the coast. Currents and wind direction also matter.

clips.send: Temperature. A measure of how hot or cold something is. At a higher temperature, particles generally move more vigorously. Even particles in a solid keep vibrating. Internal energy (nèinéng). Add the energy from particles’ motion to the potential energy from their interactions to get the object’s internal energy. Internal energy depends on factors such as temperature, mass, and state. Ice has internal energy, too. Heat (rèliàng). Energy transferred because of a temperature difference, measured in joules (J). The net transfer by heat is from higher to lower temperature. Molecules are always moving randomly. During diffusion (kuòsàn, 扩散), particles move in all directions, with an overall spread from higher to lower concentration. They keep moving after the gases are mixed. Molecules also exert forces on one another. At very close range they repel, and at somewhat greater distances attraction can hold them together.

Work done on it or heat entering it can add energy. Work it does or heat leaving it can take energy out.

clips.send: Energy can transfer or change form, and the total energy of an isolated system stays constant. Our system is both samples of water. We ignore energy absorbed by the cup, heat exchange with the room, and evaporation, and treat water’s specific heat as constant. The energy the hot water loses is gained by the cool water. Both end at the same temperature, a state called thermal equilibrium.

clips.send: A fuel’s heating value (rèzhí, 热值), q, is the energy released per unit mass in complete combustion, measured in J/kg. Use the heating value given in a calculation problem. Efficiency η is useful work W divided by the energy Q released by complete combustion. The remaining energy still counts in the total. Much of it leaves in hot exhaust or through the cooling system. Friction also converts some mechanical energy into internal energy.

A flywheel and other rotating parts help carry the engine through the other strokes.

clips.send: Specific heat capacity (bǐrèróng, 比热容), c, is the energy needed to warm one kilogram of a material by 1 degrees Celsius . We use about 4,200 J/(kg· degrees Celsius ) for water and about 800 J/(kg· degrees Celsius ) for dry sand. For equal masses given equal energy, the sample with the larger c warms less.
clips.text: Specific heat capacity (bǐrèróng, 比热容), c, is the energy needed to warm one kilogram of a material by 1 °C. We use about 4,200 J/(kg·°C) for water and about 800 J/(kg·°C) for dry sand. For equal masses given equal energy, the sample with the larger c warms less.

clips.send: 进气门打开，排气门关闭。活塞向下运动，空气和汽油的混合物进入气缸。 这是简化的火花点火汽油机。四个冲程使曲轴转两周（720 度 ），其中做功冲程中燃气推动活塞。飞轮等旋转部件的惯性有助于维持其余冲程。

clips.send: 海水的比热容比许多陆地材料大。暖季海洋吸收大量能量，升温较慢；冷季海洋释放能量，降温也较慢。风把受海洋影响的空气带到陆地时，沿海地区的气温变化往往较小。洋流和风向也会影响这种调节作用。

clips.send: 燃料的热值 q 表示单位质量的燃料完全燃烧时放出的热量，单位为 J/kg。计算时用题目给出的热值。 热机效率 η 等于有用功 W 除以燃料完全燃烧放出的热量 Q。其余能量仍计入总量，例如随高温废气带走，或通过冷却系统传给周围。摩擦也会使部分机械能转化为内能。

clips.send: 温度。表示物体的冷热程度。温度越高，粒子的热运动通常越剧烈。固体中的粒子也一直在振动。内能。把物体内粒子热运动的动能与粒子间相互作用的势能加在一起，就得到物体的内能。内能与温度、质量、物态等有关。冰也有内能。热量。由于温度差而转移的能量，单位是焦耳，J。发生热传递时，能量自发地从高温处净转移到低温处。 分子一直在做无规则运动。扩散时，分子向各个方向运动，但从浓度较高处到浓度较低处的分子总体上更多。混合均匀后，分子仍在运动。 分子之间也有相互作用。分子靠得很近时，斥力的作用明显；在稍远的距离，引力可以把分子拉在一起。

clips.send: 太阳发出的电磁波穿过太空，将能量带到地球。地面吸收其中一部分辐射而升温。热辐射可以在真空中传递能量。 先确定研究对象。对它做功或使它吸热，能量可以进入；它对外做功或放热，能量可以转出。

clips.send: 两个气门仍关闭。燃烧使燃气的温度和压强升高。燃气膨胀，推动活塞向下做功，带动曲轴转动。 这是简化的火花点火汽油机。四个冲程使曲轴转两周（720 度 ），其中做功冲程中燃气推动活塞。飞轮等旋转部件的惯性有助于维持其余冲程。

clips.send: 两个气门都关闭。活塞向上运动，对混合气体做功，使气体的压强和温度升高。接近冲程末端时，火花塞点火。 这是简化的火花点火汽油机。四个冲程使曲轴转两周（720 度 ），其中做功冲程中燃气推动活塞。飞轮等旋转部件的惯性有助于维持其余冲程。

clips.send: 向下推活塞，活塞对密闭的空气做功。压缩很快时，热量来不及大量传出，空气的内能增加，温度升高。 先确定研究对象。对它做功或使它吸热，能量可以进入；它对外做功或放热，能量可以转出。

clips.send: 金属勺浸在热汤里的一端先变热。金属中相邻粒子的相互作用以及自由电子的运动会把能量传向勺柄。 先确定研究对象。对它做功或使它吸热，能量可以进入；它对外做功或放热，能量可以转出。

clips.send: 能量可以转移或转化，孤立系统的总能量保持不变。这里把两份水作为一个系统，忽略杯子吸热、向外散热和蒸发，并把水的比热容看作恒定。热水减少的内能等于冷水增加的内能。两份水温度相同时，就达到了热平衡。
